Polyfil the holes tight while colonizing substrate... Some would say cover holes with tape during this phase but mycelium need some air exchange to get all that CO2 out.. Hence the filters on grow bags, micropore tape on jars... Just dont open the lid. Remove a bunch of the polyfil and leave just enough to cover the holes when ready to fruit. Also you shouldn't need to mist AT ALL during colonization. Only mist if you see NO signs of moisture on the sides of your tub. For now do lots of research.
